h.loadHint: Share of each profile's capacity in use, per week. A profile at 100% over the whole period is the bottleneck; an empty profile waits for work.
rename.title: Rename
team.title: Team composition
team.hint: In full-time equivalents: 1.5 = one person full time and one half time. The columns on the right give the effect of one full-time more or less on the date of the last release, in each mode.
settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Dates, other teams and calculation rules. Each change recomputes the schedule at once.
dates.title: Dates
dates.hint: The remaining work starts at the wished start, never before today. A wished go-live comes from the framing or from the human; empty, no deadline.
ext.title: Other teams
ext.hint: Deliveries expected from teams outside the project, on the date they commit to. The schedule waits for each delivery before starting what depends on it. The duration of their task only draws their bar.
agents.title: Agent team
agents.hint: For the autonomous AI mode: how many agents work in parallel. The PO and the acceptance helper come from the Team composition section.
agents.hours: {n} h of work per day each
rules.title: Calculation rules
rules.hint: How the schedule turns the team and the estimates into dates. The same for the three modes.
rules.loss: Time lost in coordination, per teammate
rules.lossHint: Each developer loses this share of their time for each teammate (discussions, synchronisation). Beyond a certain size, adding someone slows the team down.
rules.maxPer: People at most on one story
rules.maxPerHint: A story is not shared between more people than this: beyond that, it does not finish sooner.
rules.rangeHint: An estimate is never exact: a story may take less (at best) or more (at worst) than planned, as a % of its estimate. In each simulation, half of the gap is shared by all the stories: estimates are often wrong in the same direction.
rules.runsHint: The schedule is replayed this many times, each time with durations drawn at random within the error margin. The probable and the prudent dates come from them. The more there are, the more stable they are and the longer the calculation.

rules.calibMeasured.one: Measured on {n} sprint: actual time divided by estimated time. It multiplies every story estimate. The measured sprints are in the Calibration section.
rules.calibMeasured.other: Measured on {n} sprints: actual time divided by estimated time. It multiplies every story estimate. The measured sprints are in the Calibration section.

rules.calibNone: No sprint measured yet: 1, no correction. It multiplies every story estimate. The measured sprints are in the Calibration section.
sum.team: The date is held by the availability of {profile}.
sum.today: The date is held by today's date: the remaining work does not start before today.
sum.start: The date is held by the wished start.
sum.ext: The date is held by an external delivery: {item}.
sum.extTeam: The date is held by an external delivery: {item} ({team}).
sum.missing: Missing skill: {skills}; the work that needs it stays blocked.
warn.title: Profiles in excess
warn.slow: {profile}: one full-time less would bring the last release forward ({list}).
warn.slowDev: The time lost in coordination exceeds what it brings.
warn.idle: {profile}: the last full-time brings no gain ({list}); one full-time less gives the same date.
ex.loss: With {n} developers (full time) in this mode, each one works {share} of their time.
ex.lossOne: With a single developer, nothing is lost.
ex.range: Example: a story estimated at {ref} takes between {lo} and {hi}.
ex.calib: Example: {factor} means that the stories took {more} more than planned.
cmp.tip: Chances of meeting the wished go-live: out of {runs} simulations, {share} deliver release {release} on {date} at the latest.
calib.none: No sprint measured yet: factor 1, the estimates are not corrected.
